description: This stacked bar chart illustrates the number of datasets categorized by year and target type. The horizontal category axis is labeled "Year" and displays discrete years in chronological order from 2012 to 2022. The vertical value axis is labeled "Number of datasets" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 160, with tick marks and corresponding horizontal grid lines at intervals of 20. The chart features stacked bars where the bottom component represents "Untargeted" datasets, colored blue, and the top component represents "Targeted" datasets, colored orange, as indicated by the "Targets" legend. The total height of the bars varies across the years, with the shortest bars occurring in 2012 and 2013 at an approximate total value of 2, and the tallest bar occurring in 2021, which reaches a total value of 160 (consisting of approximately 67 untargeted and 93 targeted datasets). The bars are sorted chronologically from left to right. The final bar for the year 2022 is visually distinguished from the others, rendered in lighter, faded shades of blue and orange, and reaches a total approximate value of 37 (approximately 10 untargeted and 27 targeted).
